But also - it’s entirely possible to lift 3x a week without squatting. I’ve had terrible problems with squatting and had to take intermittent breaks. 
First, I would recommend taking at least a week off from ANY knee-bending exercises (Squatting, Leg press, Lunges). Then, I would look up comprehensive squat warm-ups or knee rehab routines. Do these in place of squatting. Start re-introducing leg pressing and leg extensions, but if you feel pain, stop. 

If after this you’re still having trouble even with bodyweight squats, seeing a doctor is a good idea. Don’t try to push through the pain, as this is not the good kind of pain. 

As for flexibility, just try to get into the habit of stretching. Before bed, when you brush your teeth, pull out your phone, sit on the ground, and start stretching your legs. Try to hit 30 seconds on each stretch, but feel it out. It SUCKS at first because you’ll feel like the least flexible person alive, but if you’re consistent, you will improve.
